commenti.body:
I didn't like it. Didn't hate it, but thought it was a too self-aware, lesser retread of earlier movies, which is a pretty common complaint. Like eating a piece of (good) pizza that someone else had chewed up first.

https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/03/movies/joker-review.html
That review summed up the way I feel about The Joker better than I could myself.
